mapper.select:
select hj.id, hj.laoren_id as laorenId, l.xingming as laorenXingming, hr.xingming as huliRenyuanXingming, hx.xiangmu_mingcheng as xiangmuMingcheng, hj.huli_shijian as huliShijian, hj.huli_shuliang as huliShuliang, hj.huli_neirong as huliNeirong, hj.laoren_fankui as laorenFankui, hj.zhuangtai from huli_jilu hj join laoren_xinxi l on hj.laoren_id = l.id join huli_renyuan hr on hj.huli_renyuan_id = hr.id join huli_xiangmu hx on hj.xiangmu_id = hx.id
hj.zhuangtai != '取消'
and l.xingming like concat('%', #{laorenXingming}, '%')
and hr.xingming like concat('%', #{huliRenyuanXingming}, '%')
and hx.xiangmu_mingcheng like concat('%', #{xiangmuMingcheng}, '%')
and date(hj.huli_shijian) = #{riqi}
order by hj.huli_shijian desc, hj.id desc
mapper.update: update huli_jilu set zhuangtai = '取消' where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select jj.id, jj.laoren_id as laorenId, l.xingming as laorenXingming, hr.xingming as huliRenyuanXingming, jj.jiance_shijian as jianceShijian, jj.tiwen, jj.gaoya, jj.diya, jj.xinlv, jj.xueyang, jj.xuetang, jj.qingkuang from jiankang_jiance jj join laoren_xinxi l on jj.laoren_id = l.id left join huli_renyuan hr on jj.huli_renyuan_id = hr.id
and l.xingming like concat('%', #{laorenXingming}, '%')
and date(jj.jiance_shijian) = #{riqi}
order by jj.jiance_shijian desc, jj.id desc
